title: schizostachyum cordatum
intro: Schizostachyum cordatum, commonly known as Rattan palm, is a type of climbing palm plant native to Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its robust stem, which is often harvested for furniture-making and other wood products. The Rattan palm has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing fever, relieving inflammation, and treating skin conditions due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Schizostachyum cordatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
